headerOverrides.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / reference-faithful illustrated asset.
Input image: the approved woodland four-tab comparison board. Use ONLY the header artwork inside the SECOND phone of the LOWER (dark) row as the visual reference. The source shows a small backpacked hiker standing on the right-hand rocky ledge, looking across layered night mountains and pine woodland.
Produce one standalone transparent PNG artwork for the dark Coach page, 1536 x 1024 pixels, landscape 3:2. Faithfully preserve this specific dark illustration's forest-green, sage, and pale moonlit-gold watercolor palette, paper-like brush texture, soft layered mountain silhouettes, fine subtle contour lines, dark pines and rocks. Place the hiker with complete head and feet on a rock in the right third, turned away surveying the valley; match the source's standing posture. Night mountain valley and pines occupy the right half and taper through the lower half. Illustration extends naturally to the right canvas edge. Upper-left approximately 55 percent stays genuinely transparent and clear for a real title; any contour-line details there must be extremely faint. Crisp readable hiker silhouette at small mobile banner size, restrained detailing, calm mood. Preserve real alpha around the irregular painted scenery; no solid rectangular background and no opaque sky panel. This is the one page header illustration, not the whole phone screen.
No UI text, no headings, no labels, no numbers, no buttons, no cards, no navigation bars, no logos, no signpost, no gear, no phone frame. Do not reproduce any page layout, app text or comparison-board labels.
